title: Books of the Bible
description: The Bible is a library of 66 books written over 1,500 years, telling one true story. Knowing how the books are grouped helps you find your way around.

waypoints.title: One Story, 66 Books
waypoints.body: The Bible isn't one book -- it's a library of 66 books, written by dozens of authors over about 1,500 years, but it tells one true story from creation to new creation.

waypoints.title: The Law — Genesis to Deuteronomy
waypoints.body: The first five books, written by Moses, tell how the world and God's people began, and give God's Law.

waypoints.title: History — Joshua to Esther
waypoints.body: Twelve books tracing Israel's story from entering the Promised Land through kings, exile, and return.

waypoints.title: Wisdom & Poetry — Job to Song of Songs
waypoints.body: Five books of poetry and wisdom for living, including Psalms (songs) and Proverbs (wise sayings).

waypoints.title: Prophets — Isaiah to Malachi
waypoints.body: Seventeen books of prophets who called God's people back to him and pointed forward to the Messiah.

waypoints.title: Gospels & Acts — Matthew to Acts
waypoints.body: Four accounts of Jesus' life, death, and resurrection, followed by the story of the early church.

waypoints.title: Letters — Romans to Jude
waypoints.body: Letters written to churches and individuals, teaching how to live as followers of Jesus.

waypoints.title: Revelation
waypoints.body: One book of vivid pictures about Jesus' final victory and the new heaven and earth to come.

waypoints.title: Where to Explore Next
waypoints.body: Pick one grouping you want to explore more this month -- which one, and why?
